{{Quote|There'll be no dying in my place!|Cantina proprietor to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Rebel Escape">{{JournalCite|7|Rebel Escape}}</ref>}}
This '''cantina proprietor''' was the manager of a [[Unidentified cantina (Mari and Boba Fett)|cantina]] in which [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] gunned down a [[Unidentified Rebel courier|mark]]. Angered, the cantina proprietor yelled at Fett to take his mark and leave the premises. Fett gave the proprietor a hefty sum of money as a compensation and left the place.

==Behind the scenes==
While unnamed, this NPC is a participant in the event that initiates the [[Rebel Escape|scenario]] that he appears in.
